description: Clean CSV pair with a durable 'Entydigt Id' column on both revisions. One activity's finish date slips and its progress drops (behind); another's progress and duration both change (ahead); a third's start date shifts but stays within tolerance (on_schedule); one activity is removed, one is added. This is the baseline 'everything works' case every later phase must keep working.
notes: changed_count reflects 4 change rows (Finish Date, Progress, Duration, Progress) plus a Start Date change on the untouched-status VENT activity — no activity's identity is ambiguous here, so this fixture is a pure control for Phases 1-4.
